name: Licensing

subjectOf.text: Legacy businesses own their code and can sue competitors who copy it, whereas open source crypto start-ups rely only on licenses, and this weaker incentive structure makes ICO investments riskier.
subjectOf.abstract: While open-source crypto start-ups have licenses that help protect them from competitor companies who may be using their code for profit, legacy businesses that own their code and can sue competitors who copy such code which provides a different incentive structure and makes ICO investments riskier.
subjectOf.citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Marco Dell'Erba, Initial Coin Offerings Emerging Practices, Risk Factors, and Red Flags (2017). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=3067615
scope_conditions: open source crypto start-ups compared to legacy code-owning businesses

subjectOf.text: Becoming an OCC regulated trust is one route by which crypto exchanges can operate nationwide without securing state level licenses in each of the 49 states that require one.
subjectOf.abstract: Becoming an OCC-regulated trust is one way crypto exchanges can operate nationwide without needing to secure state-level licenses in each of the 49 different U.S. states (Montana doesn't have a licensing requirement).
subjectOf.citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Hayley Howe, Custody of Digital Assets (2021). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=3936876
scope_conditions: United States, national trust charter route

subjectOf.text: BaFin applies substance over form, so transferable, tradable, or profit-oriented reward units risk classification as crypto-assets or financial instruments in Germany, potentially triggering licensing obligations such as crypto custody or proprietary trading.
subjectOf.abstract: BaFin applies substance-over-form. This means that transferable, tradable, or profit-oriented reward units risk classification as crypto-assets/financial instruments, potentially implicating licensing (e.g., crypto custody, proprietary trading).
subjectOf.citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Liquid Equity Rewards (2025). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=5454054
scope_conditions: reward units that are transferable, tradable, or profit-oriented
